root_cause.explanation: All 4 lines carry OA-18; claim-level MOA N111 confirms no appeal right. A prior claim for member 1ER2YR8UK79, DOS 2026-07-05, procedures 97140/97110 was already adjudicated at Novitas when PA22957514 was submitted as CLM05-3=1.

next_action.detail: OA-18 is hard-coded and unappealable; stop resubmitting PA22957514. Query Novitas portal or IVR for the prior claim on DOS 2026-07-05. If it paid, post and close. If it was denied, address that claim via Telephone Reopenings — not a new submission.
